item.title: Hiochimura Gangu Tanetsuke Rankou no Shou
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: High End
  • 発売日: 2012-03-10
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 緋落村玩具 種付け乱交の章
  • 英語名: Hiochimura Gangu Tanetsuke Rankou no Shou

别名

  • Gangs of Ochimura‛： The Mating Orgy

あらすじ

In the legendary “village of fugitives”,

young rich girls are abducted by a twisted gang for an orgy unlike any other.

You met one of the girls, and she begged for help,

but in trying to free the girls your fate was sealed…
